scope: Actual scoring cue rules and original-versus-edited simulation parity; no player satisfaction claim.

checks.name: chips only follow real kill attribution, while trick and nested combo additions reconcile
short-flight landing reveals every remaining trick and banks once without RNG
Lucky, ordered charms and Gold growth use authoritative pre-growth bank values
one thousand draw/upgrade combinations preserve exact final results
a bailed trick reveals as a Bail, adds nothing and the final cue equals the bank
a bust stops the reels and banks zero (half with Second wind) through the same cue
